scope: Static technology and implementation-readiness audit of APP_MATH-main

decisions.decision: Keep existing TypeScript + React Native + Expo Router + Hermes + New Architecture mobile stack and Next.js App Router + TypeScript web stack.
Keep @rive-app/react-native 0.4.20 and Nitro 0.33.2 for the first real adapter; use async APIs and data binding; evaluate 0.5 beta only in an isolated spike.
decisions.compatibility_uncertainty: Official docs describe v0.5 as beta and recommend latest v0.4 async migration first. Actual native build compatibility remains unverified here.

decisions.decision: Add no web Rive dependency until a real asset exists; then benchmark react-webgl2 versus react-canvas with one character and explicit client-only lifecycle.
decisions.compatibility_uncertainty: No current Rive web package or .riv asset exists in repository.

decisions.decision: Keep semantic events in shared contracts and insert platform-specific Rive adapters; no Rive names in learning engine.
Use 2D vector Rive with depth illusion for characters; use Skia only for a benchmarked custom mini-game; do not introduce Unity or a 3D rewrite.
decisions.compatibility_uncertainty: Do not infer broad 3D support in RN/Web from runtime-specific renderer documentation.

decisions.decision: Pass prefersReducedMotion into Rive data binding and provide a static semantic fallback; do not rely only on wrapper scale.
decisions.current_status: fail_in_production_path; mobile reduced-motion component is not used by StationFlow and web CSS animation has no preference path

decisions.decision: Implement additive profile.avatar schema v2 with deterministic default, draft/save/cancel, revision/idempotency; keep child avatar separate from guide characters.
decisions.current_status: not_ready; design contract exists but is not connected to product state

decisions.decision: Do not silently accept post-onboarding state updates when saveState fails; await/report/retry persistence before claiming resume/progress is saved.
Make mobile queue writes atomic/serialized and add app lifecycle/network reconnect flush; explicitly choose offline-start policy.
decisions.current_status: not_ready; no mobile reconnect listener/flush found

decisions.decision: Replace unsigned base64 teacher cookie with signed/opaque server session and remove dev credential/header bypasses from production.
decisions.current_status: not_ready_for_production; static risk, exploit not executed

decisions.decision: Treat 60 FPS/16.67ms, sync batch <=20, cache <=80MB as contracts; require release-build low-end Android profiling before pilot.

pilot_candidate: signed auth and production dev-bypass exclusion
state write failure/retry/low-storage and kill/relaunch persistence tests
pilot: release EAS low-end Android frame p95/p99 and dropped-frame profile
Rive idle/think/correct/celebrate and lesson transition profile

limitations: No .riv asset was present; Rive rendering and native compatibility are unverified.
No real FPS, memory, startup, battery or network benchmark exists in this audit.
Auth risk is static evidence; no exploit or staging verification was performed.
